snippet.title: Sonic Adventure Advanced - Teaser 1
snippet.description:
Sonic Adventure Advanced is a 2D fan game re-creation of Sonic Adventure. A demo is going to be coming soon.  Follow progress on X: https://x.com/SAdv_Advanced and SFGHQ Forums: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/threads/sonic-adventure-advanced.1378/
